name: ashish-claude-skills
description: Ashish's Claude Code skills: engineering quality gates for TypeScript, tests and audits.

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: TypeScript types, Vitest and Playwright tests, security, login and access, personal data and privacy, threat modelling before launch, design and UX audits, and CLAUDE.md sync. Skills only; add quality-gates-hook for a per-file nudge.

plugins.name: quality-gates-hook
plugins.description: Optional companion to quality-gates: a hook that names the right quality-gates skill for the file being edited, once per session. Needs python3.

plugins.name: confluence-diagrams
plugins.description: Turns a Confluence page into validated, explorable HTML diagrams through archify, citing the page section behind every node.

plugins.name: plugin-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of installed plugins and skills: security scan of hooks, scripts, MCP configs and SKILL.md text, plus a workflow map of overlaps, keep-or-drop picks and hook conflicts.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Picks the cheapest Claude model and effort that fits the work, and when a long session should stay, use a subagent or start fresh, with a carry-over brief for artifacts. Skills only; add switchboard-hook for automatic per-prompt routing.

plugins.name: switchboard-hook
plugins.description: Optional companion to switchboard: a UserPromptSubmit hook that routes each prompt to the cheapest model and effort that fits, in a subagent, and flags large sessions. Needs python3.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: New-feature requests run as Opus plan -> checklist -> Sonnet (medium effort) build and test in fresh-context subagents, finishing with README.md updated. Skills only; add feature-flow-hook for automatic detection and the README gate.

plugins.name: feature-flow-hook
plugins.description: Optional companion, own marketplace only. Companion to feature-flow: a UserPromptSubmit hook that spots new-feature requests and points Claude at feature-flow:new-feature, and a Stop hook that will not let a turn end while a feature checklist is in progress, code changed and README.md did not. Needs feature-flow installed and python3 on the PATH.

plugins.name: vibe-coder
plugins.description: Everyday coding habits and pre-launch checks: private preview links, context-saving rules, explicit state machines, bug triage, and front-end and back-end audits before a site goes live. Add vibe-coder-local for the improve retro and the output-trimming hook.

plugins.name: vibe-coder-local
plugins.description: Optional companion, own marketplace only. Companion to vibe-coder with the parts that run local scripts: the improve retro, which reads this project's past session transcripts for repeated mistakes and fixes their cause, and a PreToolUse hook that trims noisy install, build and test output. Needs python3 on the PATH.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Makes a change easy for a human to review: a one-screen reviewer brief and a splitter that cuts a large diff into small stacked PRs. Add pr-review-local for Claude Code token spend broken down by PR.

plugins.name: pr-review-local
plugins.description: Optional companion, own marketplace only. Companion to pr-review: agent-spend, which breaks Claude Code token spend down by repo, branch and PR from your local transcripts, with PRs mapped through gh. Needs python3 on the PATH.

plugins.name: repo-health
plugins.description: Any-stack repo checks: an environment doctor, API drift between server routes and client calls, and vendor-neutral feature-flag cleanup.

plugins.name: design-gate
plugins.description: Checks a built UI against its design mock (Figma, image, PDF, HTML or claude.ai artifact) in every aspect: missing screens, sections, controls and features, content, states, layout and visual tokens. It also keeps the gap report current when the mock changes, and drafts designer questions. Gap checklists are written for Sonnet subagents to work through cold, and each gap is re-checked. Add design-gate-local for the AI-slop gate and a hook that reminds you to re-check after UI edits.

plugins.name: design-gate-local
plugins.description: Optional companion, own marketplace only. Companion to design-gate with the parts that run code: slop-check, which gates a diff for AI design slop with an in-browser scan (the mock and design tokens are the allow-list), and a PostToolUse hook that reminds you to re-check design-gate reports after UI edits. The hook needs python3 on the PATH.

plugins.name: directory-readiness
plugins.description: Checks a plugin and its skills against the Claude directory pre-submission checklist and Software Directory Policy before you submit: portal-style Blocks, reviewer Holds and Warnings, per-app support, and draft data-handling answers. Includes a read-only stdlib python3 checker.
